Definition: from G5571 and G3686; untruly named:--falsely so called.
BiblicalUsage: Pseudonymos means falsely named, falsely so called. It appears once, in Paul's last charge to Timothy: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe knowledge that is falsely named is the most dangerous kind, because it wears the name of science and speaks against the faith.
